ctx.x: : Until you got -- until Ivie Anderson came with the band.
Steady -- Ivie was the first, when we went on the road. Ivie never worked in New York at the Cotton Club with us, because Ivie joined us in Chicago. She was working

at the Grand Terrace with Father Hines Band so there was another girl named May Alex, so she was entertaining around New York, so we were going to the Coast to make "Check and Double Check," Amos and Andy, the biggest thing in radio, wasn't no TV. We made the picture, so we went to Chicago and we played at the Oriental Theatre, yes, and so it was a tossup between May Alex and Irving Mills says, "We should have a female vocalist for this engagement. Ivie Anderson was a very, very cute little brown-skinned girl.
